title: Genome-Factory: A Library for Tuning, Deploying, and Interpreting Genomic Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2509.12266v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce Genome-Factory, the first integrated Python library for tuning, deploying, and interpreting genomic foundation models. Our core contribution is to simplify and unify the workflow for genomic model development: data collection, model tuning, inference, benchmarking, and interpretability. For data collection, Genome-Factory offers an automated pipeline to download genomic sequences and preprocess them. For model tuning, Genome-Factory supports both full and parameter-efficient fine-tuning across diverse genomic models. For inference, Genome-Factory enables both embedding extraction and DNA sequence generation. For benchmarking, we include two existing benchmarks and provide a flexible interface to incorporate additional benchmarks. For interpretability, Genome-Factory introduces an open-source biological interpreter based on a sparse auto-encoder. We validate the utility of Genome-Factory across three dimensions: (i)

translated_title: Genome-Factory：一个用于调优、部署和解释基因组基础模型的库
translated_abstract: 我们推出了Genome-Factory，这是首个用于调优、部署和解释基因组基础模型的集成化Python库。我们的核心贡献是简化和统一基因组模型开发的工作流程，涵盖数据收集、模型调优、推理、基准测试和可解释性五个环节。在数据收集方面，Genome-Factory提供了自动化流程来下载和预处理基因组序列；在模型调优方面，它支持跨多种基因组模型的全量微调和参数高效微调；在推理方面，它支持嵌入提取和DNA序列生成；在基准测试方面，我们集成了两个现有基准测试，并提供了灵活的接口以纳入更多基准测试；在可解释性方面，Genome-Factory引入了基于稀疏自编码器的开源生物解释器。我们从三个维度验证了Genome-Factory的实用性：（i）
tldr: Genome-Factory是首个统一了基因组基础模型数据收集、微调、推理、基准测试和可解释性分析的集成Python库，并推出了基于稀疏自编码器的开源生物解释器。
en_tdlr: Genome-Factory is the first integrated Python library that unifies data collection, fine-tuning, inference, benchmarking, and interpretability for genomic foundation models, featuring an open-source biological interpreter based on sparse auto-encoders.
